description: This bar chart illustrates the self-report accuracy of two large language models, GPT-40 and GPT-40-mini, under three experimental conditions: a control condition, before introspection training, and after introspection training. The vertical axis, labeled “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled)”, ranges from 0.00 to 1.00 in increments of 0.25, indicating the proportion of accurate self-reports. The horizontal axis displays the two models, with grouped bars for each. The legend identifies gray bars as “Control”, light blue as “Before Introspection Training”, and dark purple as “After Introspection Training”. For GPT-40, the control bar is approximately 0.15, rising to about 0.65 before training and reaching roughly 0.85 after training. For GPT-40-mini, the control bar is near 0.05, increasing to approximately 0.75 before training and peaking at about 0.95 after training. Error bars are present on all bars, indicating variability or confidence intervals. The chart visually demonstrates that self-report accuracy improves substantially after introspection training for both models, with GPT-40-mini showing higher absolute accuracy post-training than GPT-40. The control condition consistently shows the lowest accuracy for both models.
